text:
Liam: hey all, brand new here. stuck on onboarding step: can't hit our internal feature flag service at 10.40.1.12 from my laptop when connected to split-tunnel WireGuard. Office network goes through fine. i'm on Ubuntu 22.04, home ISP modem/router — any quick tips?

Maya (Infra): welcome! probably CG-NAT or your home NAT causing hairpin issues. can you paste `ip route get 10.40.1.12` and `ip addr show` and `systemd-resolve --status`? also which interface does wg show as (wg0?)

Liam: pasted:
```
$ ip route get 10.40.1.12
10.40.1.12 via 100.64.0.2 dev eth0 src 192.168.50.10
    cache
$ ip addr show
2: eth0: <BROADCAST,MULTICAST,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1500 qdisc mq state UP group default qlen 1000
    inet 192.168.50.10/24 brd 192.168.50.255 scope global dynamic eth0
5: wg0: <POINTOPOINT,UP,LOWER_UP> mtu 1420 qdisc noqueue state UNKNOWN group default qlen 1000
    inet 10.200.0.5/32 scope global wg0
$ systemd-resolve --status
Global
       DNS Servers: 10.200.4.2
Link 2 (eth0)
      DNS Servers: 192.168.50.1

```

Maya (Infra): yep that shows kernel chooses 100.64.x as next-hop so packets leave local LAN and hit ISP CG-NAT. Two options: 1) add policy route to force 10.40.0.0/14 via wg0: `sudo ip route add 10.40.0.0/14 dev wg0` OR `sudo ip rule add from 10.200.0.5 table 200 && sudo ip route add default dev wg0 table 200` if you need source-based routing. 2) if you prefer not fiddling, use SSH local port-forward or socks via bastion: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rdw -L 5000:10.40.1.12:80 rdw-bastion-prime` then curl localhost:5000.

Jorge (Security): quick note: if you add routes locally, make sure your firewall (ufw/iptables) allows traffic on wg0 and that you don't accidentally tunnel all traffic unless you want full-tunnel. we recommend route-only for the internal subnets used by services. Also mention WSL2 users: WSL2 NAT can complicate routing — prefer the bastion tunnel for Windows devs or enable full-tunnel in the client for the lab period.

Liam: added `sudo ip route add 10.40.0.0/14 dev wg0` and pings now reach the service. build of the onboarding test suite succeeded. thanks!

Maya (Infra): awesome. i'll add a short 'home NAT' checklist to the new-hire playbook and a small script that detects 100.64.0.0/10 as the gateway and prints the suggested `ip route` command.

Onboard Bot: Created INF-648: "New-hire: detect CG-NAT and suggest split-tunnel route fix" assigned to Infrastructure.

Liam: leaving notes here in case others hit WSL/WSL2 + CG-NAT. super helpful team :grin:
